item.description: Two minor boys were among six members of a family seriously wounded by their father who went on a slashing spree in Assam’s Majuli on Sunday. item.description: Cachar police have once again busted a case of medical fraud with the arrest of a fake doctor who had been practising for years by using forged credentials.
